title: I8: What John must decide
public_pr_body:
One-page decision sheet drawn from the I7 handover: scope, policy/objectives, procedure owners, retention, remaining risk and audit readiness. Decision and date fields remain blank.

Tolra supports JNR’s quality work; software/documents cannot certify JNR. JNR is audited.

- [x] Source and whitespace checks; published tree matches local commit.
- [ ] John/Rhys reviews actual installed system, company decisions and evidence.

Builder 5 / I8, explicit Rhys assignment; atomic claim claims/I8. One document under docs/iso9001/, independent of other drafts. No runtime tests or live exports run. No feature build, Ready label, main merge or production SQL. Builders 3/4 unchanged. Handover and remaining decisions are recorded in the document; existing I1–I7 drafts remain unchanged.
